failures.issue: Insight prose does not embed the sourced numeric value. The text should state the exact ROE figure from V.ratio.return_on_average_equity (e.g., "Visa’s return on average equity is 52.07 %…") rather than a vague “exceeds fifty percent”.

Valuation Insights contains unregistered numerical language (e.g., “moderate leverage profile”) and any numbers not expressed via [[catalog.key]] placeholders. All quantitative statements must rely exclusively on the provided catalog tokens; remove or re‑phrase unsupported numeric descriptors and ensure no numbered lists are present.
